brief: A closed electronics enclosure with a louvred vent so the board inside can breathe.

finish.summary: Single-cell closed enclosure: full base with top cover and all side faces capped, louvre port vent in one wall, and third-depth Pi-post bin inside as the board mount. Staged with bench electronics props.
